notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v0.97
notes.content:
We are thrilled to share our first ever patch note! First of all, we would like to thank the following individuals for their valuable feedback:  [b]DanTheDracoKingVT, Rooslin, Morfo2, Aphex, Bobsenas, Collider Flarespark, Darkenneko, Feepy, sw00p, Cody.[/b] Your feedback helps us continuously improve the game!

Changes and improvements in this update:
[list]
[*] Now automatically adjust according to your monitor.
[*] A new setting to mute the microphone has been added.
[*] Updated for a more user-friendly experience.
[*] Fixed a camera bug that was causing unnecessary lag and stuttering.
[*] Improved to prevent recurring connection issues.
[*] Improved item interaction systems.
[*] Improved visual guidance.
[*] Various improvements for a better navigation experience.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the mermaids voice to disappear.
[*] Fixed excessive shaking when turning the ship.
[*] Added a new tutorial for interactable objects on the ship.
[*] Fixed the shaking issue with interactable objects.
[*] Fixed the bug where players couldn’t exit the ship objects after interaction.
[*] Improved the ship model for easier use of ladders.
[*] Improved the ship model for easier use of ladders.
[*] Performance updates for smoother gameplay.
[/list]

Upcoming features:
[list]
[*] A three slot inventory system like Content Warning and Lethal Company.
[*] Various zany items.
[*] Fishing. (must have)
[*] A new sea creature and a new creature that spawns in the houses.
[*] New places and areas to explore.
[/list]

Your feedback is invaluable to us! If you have any suggestions or encounter any issues, do not hesitate to share them with us. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The state and the future of our game
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy mateys![/h2]
Today we will briefly discuss our the state and the future of the game.

[h3]Another lesson learned[/h3]
As you may know, our demo release have been rocky at best. While we are aware that this is below sub optimal, we have some shameless excuses for this:
[olist]
[*] We are a tiny, tiny team of two developers, with experience around 3 years, who are trying to make something that they want to make.
[*] We wanted to let the world know as soon as possible, and let the world play as soon as possible.
[*] It was an insane oversight on our part due to our lack of experience. This is the first time we ever create something for Steam, first time we ever made anything multiplayer.
[/olist]
You may or may not consider these excuses to be valid, we respect your opinion. We are extremely sorry if your experience with our game was (or maybe still is) unpleasant. We promise that we will not leave the demo in a state like this, and promise that we will not hastily publish an unbroken game. We hope that you will understand our situation. We learned our lesson. The hard way.

[h3]The future of the game[/h3]
As for a brighter topic change, let's talk about the roadmap, or rather the features we want to add to the finished project:
[list]
[*] Minigames you can play with your crewmates.
[*] Ship upgrades. (upgrades to speed, hull armor, etc.)
[*] Different ships.
[*] Items to deal with the monsters.
[*] A plathera of original monsters. We have around 15 different monsters conceptualized. (we will talk about some of them briefly!)
[*] Polish according to YOUR feedback.
[*] A better lobby creation system. Current lobby system and networking issues are products of our inexperience. But we've learned a lot both while and after making the lobby system.
[*] More islands. The distance between the islands will be longer, so the journeys will be longer aswell.
[*] Spawn zones for enemies. Enemies will spawn in certain seas, some sort of biome system. 
[/list]
There are even more things we want to add to our little game, but these are some of the most exciting ones we have! Especially monsters, because who doesn't like a good monster design such as:
[list]
[*] A monster that disrupts navigational instruments to lure you to itself
[*] A monster that stays on the edge of vision and teleports close by when no one is looking, leaving messages then attacking a random player
[*] A monster that is a huge beast who patrols the seas, sensitive to sound and shiny lights
[*] A monster that marks a player, the marked player must not stop moving for more than 10 seconds (reverse weeping angel)
[/list]
And then some. Currently we are working to keep our demo stable. With the end of Next Fest, our development cycle will begin again, and we will start working on the stuff I have mentioned as soon as possible. Expect an early access version of our game soon!

[h3] A word of gratitude [/h3]
Thank you to everyone who gave us feedback on our project up to this point. We appreciate even if you have done nothing more than just clicking the give feedback button. It means the whole world to us. And when you give feedback, [i]please please please do not think that we will get offended[/i]. We love to see that people care enough to let us know of our mistakes. It's very humbling, yes, but also very fulfilling. Again, thank you so very much to everyone who gave their invaluable feedback to our game.

Until next time, Mariners!
